breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the dynamic amplification from a suddenly applied load; for a linear elastic bar, the peak stress is not the same as the static stress.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the dynamic amplification factor of 2 for a suddenly applied load, deriving σ_max = 2P/A = 53.33 MPa. It explicitly uses the energy method (equating external work P·δ_max to strain energy (1/2)k·δ_max^2) to arrive at δ_max = 2P/k, rather than incorrectly stating the peak stress equals the static stress P/A. This directly fixes the inconsistency present in the incomplete prompt.
